data_fields.name: actor_marker_lod_zoom
data_fields.donor_constant: 1024 (5 px above, 2 px at or below)

data_fields.name: presence_range_outdoor_reference
data_fields.donor_constant: 5632 (octagonal length, minus radius); donor gates on flag not radius

best_idea: A radar that draws only server-sent, presence-gated blips at a zoom-scaled marker size, with an 8-sector arrow from one yaw table and a compass strip that scrolls 240 px per turn.
decision_why: Keep presence-gated blips, zoom LOD markers and the 8-sector arrow; server sends the blip list, client draws it; marker size chosen for 375 px instead of the donor's 2 px default.
acceptance: At 375 px wide, a fixed-snapshot test shows the arrow in sector 3 at yaw 1000 and draws a hostile blip only inside the server presence gate; a second test asserts hover readout centre equals draw centre.
